title: IECG: Weakly-Supervised Interpretability-Enhancing Foundation Model for Electrocardiogram
abstract: arXiv:2610.28083v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electrocardiography (ECG) is a cornerstone of cardiac diagnosis, yet most machine learning methods for ECG analysis lack interpretability, limiting their clinical adoption. We present IECG, a weakly-supervised ECG foundation model that jointly performs diagnostic classification and abnormality localization without requiring manual abnormal region annotations, overcoming a long-standing bottleneck in interpretable ECG learning. Central to IECG is a weakly-supervised attention strategy that explicitly incorporates clinical priors by deriving abnormality heatmap pseudo-labels from established ECG clinical knowledge. These pseudo-labels guide the model's CLS-token attention through a KL-divergence loss, encouraging it to focus on diagnostically relevant waveform regions. translated_title: IECG：面向心电图的可解释性增强弱监督基础模型
translated_abstract: 心电图（ECG）是心脏诊断的基石，然而大多数用于心电图分析的机器学习方法缺乏可解释性，限制了其临床应用。我们提出了IECG，一个弱监督的心电图基础模型，它无需人工异常区域标注，即可同时执行诊断分类和异常定位，克服了可解释心电图学习中长期存在的瓶颈。IECG的核心是一种弱监督注意力策略，它从既有心电图临床知识中推导异常热图伪标签，从而显式地融入临床先验。这些伪标签通过KL散度损失引导模型的CLS-token注意力，促使其聚焦于具有诊断意义的波形区域。在预训练阶段，IECG通过临床引导的注意力监督、心电图-文本对比对齐以及报告生成等多个目标进行联合优化，使其能够……
tldr: IECG是一种弱监督心电图基础模型，通过将既有临床知识转化为注意力监督伪标签，在无需人工异常标注的情况下同时实现诊断分类与异常定位，显著提升了心电图AI模型的可解释性。
en_tdlr: IECG is a weakly-supervised ECG foundation model that derives attention-supervision pseudo-labels from established clinical knowledge, enabling joint diagnostic classification and abnormality localization without manual annotations, thereby greatly enhancing the interpretability of ECG AI models.
